AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Saturn is an AI agent that runs on this phone. It does multi-step work by itself: runs commands, browses the web, writes files (web pages, documents, scripts), uses phone features and sets timers. It uses the AI model the user configured inside Saturn. Operational Patterns: - Use 'startTask' when the user asks Saturn (or 'my agent') to do something; pass their request as the instruction, in their words. - Tasks run in the background and can take minutes. Use 'getTask' to report progress or Saturn's answer; don't start a duplicate task. - If a task's status is 'needs the user's answer', relay Saturn's latest reply and send the user's answer with 'continueTask'. - Use 'listArtifacts' when the user asks what Saturn made for them. Constraints: - Instructions and follow-ups must not be blank. - Task numbers come from 'startTask' or 'listTasks'.
AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Saturn is an AI agent on this phone. Start tasks, follow up on them, check their progress and list the files Saturn made.
